title: Pass By Reference Lab
description: Pratique passagem por referência em objetos JavaScript.
lab_description: Pratique passagem por referência em objetos JavaScript.

steps.title: Write a function `greenEnergy()` that has an object as a parameter and sets that object's `'Fuel Type'` property to `'avocado oil'`.
steps.hint: Use bracket notation: object['Fuel Type'] = 'avocado oil'

steps.title: Write a function `remotelyDisable()` that takes an object as a parameter and sets that object's `disabled` property to `true`.
